Definition: properly, a bubbling up, i.e. of water, a wave; of earth, mire or clay (cement); also a heap; hence, a chomer or dry measure
BiblicalUsage: 1) cement, mortar, clay; 1a) mortar, cement; 1b) clay; 1c) mire; 2) heap; 2a) swelling, surging (of water); 3) homer-a unit of dry measure about 65 imperial gallons (300 l)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
